title: Production Control Memo: Line Requeue for Rebuilds on Orders With Company-Cause Remakes (Factory Production Orders)
content:
**Memo.** For Factory Production Orders, line requeueing adds business days to the rebuild of a customer specification remake by the company-cause remakes recorded on the order — remakes with cause factory defect, freight damage or company mismeasure:

| Company-cause remakes recorded on the order | Business days added |
|---|---|
| two or more | the class production queue days plus 3 |
| exactly one | the class production queue days |
| none | none |

The days form part of the remake lead, counted in whole business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) from the rebuild start date; the end of that lead is the remake revised ship date.

## Class production queue days and the resulting figures

| Build class | Production queue | One company-cause remake | Two or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 3 | 3 | 6 |
| Custom Color Build | 3 | 3 | 6 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 5 | 5 | 8 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 5 | 5 | 8 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 5 | 5 | 8 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 7 | 7 | 10 |

## Points of reading

- Each remake record on the order's milestone records with one of the three company causes counts once, whatever number of units it covers. A unit failing the factory quality check is remade as a factory defect and is counted.
- Remakes recorded with cause customer specification error are not company-cause remakes and are not counted here.
- Hypothetical case: a Specialty Glass Build order with one factory defect remake and one freight damage remake adds 8 business days.
